subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A3099/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341
A) LGGG B) 2609010500 C) 2610280900
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3069/26 (270906 EUECYIYN AUG 2026).
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS A3800/26 AND A3788/26 (280736 AND 261347
EUECYIYN AUG 2026).
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS
A3800/26 AND A3788/26 (280736 AND 261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026) ARE NULL
AND VOID SINCE THEY REFER TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN
ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS
IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC
AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND
THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC UNITS.
FURTHERMORE THE HELLENIC POSITIONS REGARDING THE SAID MILITARY
ACTIVITIES ANNOUNCED BY REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A3788/26 EUECYIYN HAVE
ALREADY BEEN EXPRESSED IN THE REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3069/25 EUECYIYN, 
WHICH IS THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, AND THEY 
REMAIN UNCHANGED.
